edge: Include assignment, PLI-error, NBA, and end-of-time reasons.
negative: Change a field/signature or callback reason.
positive: Type-check the callback record/function and assert every reason mapping.

edge: Do not include vpi_compatibility.h directly in the test.
negative: Omit or defer the compatibility include.
positive: Include only vpi_user.h and verify an applicable compatibility mapping is visible.

edge: Predefine SVPI_TYPES or PLI_TYPES with compatible caller definitions and separately verify the unconditional vpiHandle definition.
negative: Check a header with a missing typedef or incompatible C type.
notes: Check C type compatibility, not extra host-width assumptions.
positive: Compile type-compatibility assertions for every PLI typedef and vpiHandle.

edge: Check severity and state enumerations independently.
negative: Change a member or state/severity mapping.
positive: Check every member/type and all state/severity values.

edge: Verify both vpiBitXNor spellings and all vpiSysFunc aliases.
negative: Check an absent alias, wrong subtype, or vpiUserDefn other than 45.
positive: Assert every listed mapping and compatibility alias.

edge: Include the deprecated vpiValid family and noncontiguous values.
negative: Omit or renumber one listed property, subtype, control, or I/O macro.
positive: Assert all remaining properties and delay subtypes, indexed values, control operations, and VPI_MCD_STDOUT.

edge: Include the negative vpiUndefined value.
negative: Check a missing property or wrong delay-mode value.
positive: Assert every generic/module property and delay-mode subtype.

edge: Check noncontiguous later-added values rather than assuming a dense enumeration.
negative: Omit or renumber one object-type macro.
positive: Compile assertions for the complete object-type name-to-value map.

edge: Include vpiNone, vpiUwire, nettype values, and vpiInterconnect.
negative: Omit or renumber one standard mapping.
positive: Assert all port/net properties, directions, and net subtypes.

edge: Predefine permitted PLI type or import/export macros and verify they are preserved.
negative: Use a header with a differing guard, platform branch, linkage wrapper, or cleanup.
positive: Preprocess C and C++ units that include the header twice and verify single inclusion and C linkage.

edge: Evaluate vpiPosedge, vpiNegedge, and vpiAnyEdge from the standard masks.
negative: Change one subtype, edge bit, or composite result.
positive: Assert all primitive, path, timing, elementary-edge, and composite-edge values.

edge: Include vpiBaseExpr, vpiWidthExpr, and vpiAutomatics.
negative: Omit or renumber one traversal macro.
positive: Compile assertions for the complete relationship macro map.

edge: Permit aliases normatively defined by Annex K within the range.
negative: Detect a private header constant assigned a value from 1 through 299.
positive: Confirm private extension definitions do not consume the reserved range.

edge: Include vpi_get64, array, va_list, variadic, and multi-index routines.
negative: Remove one declaration or change one return/parameter signature.
notes: Clause 38 owns runtime behavior; this record owns declarations.
positive: Assign every routine to a pointer having its exact Annex K prototype.

edge: Repeat with permitted caller-supplied PLI_VEXTERN and PLI_DLLESPEC definitions.
negative: Remove the declaration or change its element type or macro-mediated declaration.
notes: Clause 38.37.2 owns provision and NULL-terminated use.
positive: Compile a type-compatible reference to vlog_startup_routines and an element under the default linkage macros.

edge: Type-check calltf, compiletf, and sizetf independently.
negative: Change a field, callback signature, or task/function value.
positive: Compile a complete initializer with correctly typed callback functions.

edge: Predefine VPI_TIME compatibly while checking the unguarded delay type.
negative: Change a member name, order, type, or time value.
positive: Compile member/type checks and assert all time constants.

edge: Exercise VPI_VECVAL and raw two-/four-state array formats.
negative: Change a union member, format/flag value, or aval/bval encoding.
positive: Check every value member/type and associated constant mapping.

edge: Check argv as PLI_BYTE8 **.
negative: Change a member name, order, or type.
positive: Compile an initializer and type-check all four members.

edge: Check required vpi_user.h availability independently of optional private extension headers.
negative: Check a simulator installation in which a VPI translation unit cannot locate vpi_user.h.
notes: Separate K.2 requirements check header content.
positive: Preprocess a C translation unit that includes vpi_user.h in the simulator's VPI development environment.
